articles.title: 268 feet tall, 1,600 years old: Meet the second-largest tree in the world. Travellers can hike through towering giant sequoias to reach this natural marvel
articles.description: The General Grant Tree, located in Kings Canyon National Park, California, stands as the world's second-largest tree, over 1,600 years old. This giant sequoia was proclaimed the Nation's Christmas Tree in 1926. Later, President Eisenhower designated it a National Shrine for fallen servicemen. The accessible General Grant Loop Trail showcases this living monument and historical sites. Visitors can explore the Fallen Monarch, Gamlin Cabin, and Centennial Stump along the path.

articles.title: Who is Zinedine Zidane’s wife? Everything you need to know about Veronique Zidane, France's greatest football icon's life partner
articles.description: Veronique Zidane, born Veronique Fernandez Lentisco on November 10, 1971, in Rodez, France, is the wife of newly appointed France head coach Zinedine Zidane. Of Spanish-Andalusian descent, she pursued dance at the prestigious Rosella Hightower School in Cannes before stepping away from professional life to raise the couple's four sons, all of whom went on to play professional football. She and Zinedine met in 1989 in Salon-de-Provence and married in 1994. Known for maintaining a deliberately private life with no verified social media presence, Veronique has remained a foundational but quiet figure throughout one of football's most celebrated careers
